# Everything this fork owns, and every mark it leaves in an upstream file.
#
# `.github/fork/verify-intact.sh` reads this file and fails if any of it has
# gone missing. It runs after every automated upstream sync, so an upstream
# merge can never quietly delete our work — the sync stops and asks instead.
#
# Format, one entry per line:
#     <path>
#     <path> | <string that must appear in it>
#
# A bare path only has to exist. With a marker, the file must also still
# contain that string — that is how a one-line hook inside an upstream file is
# protected, since the file itself will always exist.
#
# Add a line here whenever the fork adds a file or touches an upstream one.

# --- files that are entirely ours -----------------------------------------
# Upstream knows nothing about these, so a merge cannot conflict with them.
# They are listed anyway to catch an accidental local deletion.

docker/ha/agent.py
docker/ha/test_agent.py
docker/ha/Dockerfile
docker/ha/bootstrap-standby.sh
docker/ha/setup-primary.sh
docker/ha/render-haproxy.sh
docker/ha/ha-cli.sh
docker/ha/README.md
docker/docker-compose.ha.yml
docker/standby.compose.yml
docker/tests/test-ha-failover.sh
docker/tests/ha-failover.compose.yml
docker/docker-compose.studio-fork.yml
docs/PLAN.md
docs/STATUS.md
.github/fork/protected-paths.txt
.github/fork/verify-intact.sh
.github/workflows/sync-upstream.yml
.github/workflows/build-studio-image.yml

apps/studio/components/interfaces/Settings/StandbyServers/__tests__/StandbyServers.utils.test.ts

# --- marks we leave inside upstream files ---------------------------------
# These are the only places an upstream change can collide with us. Keeping
# the list short is the whole fork-maintenance strategy: the smaller our
# footprint in files upstream also edits, the less there is to resolve.

docker/run.sh              | exec sh ha/ha-cli.sh
docker/.gitattributes      | *.py eol=lf
docker/.env.example        | HA_FAILOVER_MODE

# The single line that puts our page in Studio's settings menu. This is the
# one spot most likely to collide: upstream edits this file often, and its
# self-hosted branch gets restructured. If a sync conflicts here, re-add the
# entry rather than reverting upstream's version of the file.
apps/studio/components/layouts/ProjectSettingsLayout/SettingsMenu.utils.tsx | settings/standby-servers
